title: Findings Theater attack path view: evidence-backed chain tab rendered only from real chain data (iteration refs, evidence refs, causal AgentReasoning links) — no fabricated connections
goal: Add an 'Attack Path' tab to Findings Theater that shows AI loop findings as a connected chain. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: this tab only renders when real chain data exists. Chain data means: each finding has an iteration_number, each causal link has an evidence_ref pointing to actual runner output or artifact, and the AgentReasoning record explicitly references both the source finding and the derived finding as a compound_chain record. If chain data is absent or incomplete, the tab does not appear. No AI-generated story drawing based on co-occurrence or assumption. The chain shown must match exactly what happened: iteration sequence, tools used, evidence captured. RENDERING: Each chain node shows: finding title, severity badge, tool that produced it, iteration number, evidence ref (click to open Evidence Replay). Arrows between nodes show: the AgentReasoning text that explains the causal link — verbatim from the stored reasoning record, not AI-generated retrospectively. Nodes without a chain link shown as 'Independent findings'. LANGUAGE: All node labels use tier-appropriate professional language. Active tier findings: 'session token exposure risk (controlled active test)'. Intrusive: 'privilege escalation vector confirmed (controlled proof under authorized scope)'. Never retrospectively escalate language — if the run was active tier, label says active tier. The chain is a factual record, not a narrative embellishment. IMPLEMENTATION: Read chain data from compound_chain_id field on findings + AgentReasoning chain_context records. Only render the tab if at least two findings share a compound_chain_id with a causal_link_ref.
scope: ChatGPT review 2026-05-06: 'Findings attack path must not be fabricated — only appear when there is real chain data: iterations, evidence refs, causal links. No AI story drawn from assumptions.' Evidence-backed only. ROE-proof language.
generation_reason: Attack path view is only valuable if it reflects real evidence. Fabricated chains based on co-occurrence would mislead operators and clients.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Tab only appears when real chain data exists. Never show a chain based on severity or tool co-occurrence alone.
constraints.evidence_gate: EVERY causal link arrow must reference a specific AgentReasoning record ID and a finding evidence_ref. If either is missing, the arrow is not drawn.
constraints.roe_language: Node labels use tier-appropriate language matching the run's authorization tier. Do not escalate language retroactively.
constraints.no_hallucination: Arrow reasoning text must be verbatim from stored AgentReasoning.thought_text. AI may not generate new causal text retrospectively.

success_criteria: Attack Path tab absent when no compound_chain_id data exists (manual scans, regression test).
Tab appears only when at least two findings share compound_chain_id with causal_link_ref.
Every arrow references a specific AgentReasoning record ID.
Causal link text is verbatim from AgentReasoning.thought_text, not AI-generated.
Node labels match the run's authorization tier language.
Independent findings shown separately, not forced into a chain.
No regression in existing Findings Theater tests.

acceptance_criteria: No chain tab for manual assessment (regression test).
Chain tab appears for ai_loop run with compound_chain data.
No generated causal text — verbatim only.
